findings.text: none of this node's fifteen commits are reachable from main: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 065fb75de6165c458b3e64f787929055c82324ff HEAD` (the node's own tip) fails, and `git for-each-ref` shows 065fb75de exists only as `worktrees/pcrf-attribute-the-exact-mode-fixed-point/HEAD`, a detached worktree ref on no branch; `git cat-file -e HEAD:benchmarks/plasma_cell_fixed_point_attribution.py` and `HEAD:docs/figures/plasma-cell-read-fidelity/exact-mode-construction-comparison.png` both fail. The plan paragraph a reader meets at HEAD is still the bare, pre-measurement stub from commit 09bccfc1c ('measurement in progress'); the four landing paragraphs, the figure and the completed/cancelled-ladder receipt links this node authored never reached main. The manifest's checkpoint says 'Both routes fail in both cases; complete paired receipt, PNG/SVG and four saved terminal states delivered' without disclosing that delivery stopped at a commit, not a landing.

the construction discriminator that explains away the plan's premise ('the stored two-trip converged receipt belongs to the solovev production construction') is asserted but not measured at the seed revision: `compare_constructions` only ran at f5af729a9 (main), and the b43714114 rung was only ever driven with one construction (its three logs are b43714114-diverted-single-null.log, -one-trip.log and -weak-rotation-reactor-static.log, no production variant) — so whether the production construction actually converges at b43714114, which is the fact that would confirm the discriminator, was never run.

status: complete carries the qualitative substitution silently: the plan's §1 done-when for this node asks for the first revision whose default-policy arm is unconverged where its predecessor converged, across all nine named landings (b43714114 through f5af729a9); the delivered receipt measures one revision (b43714114, both cases) plus a same-revision construction comparison at f5af729a9, with 10 of 18 ladder arms recorded not-run and 6 not-measured — a self-disclosed partial-ladder verdict inside the JSON artifact itself ('no claim of an all-revision measurement'), but the manifest's terminal checkpoint line reads as an unqualified completion.

Every commit is well-formed (conventional subject plus body, no AI attribution, no plan-label leakage) and the tip 065fb75de is a clean worktree. item_verdicts.done_when: not met as written and not disclosed as unmet in a landed record: the receipt does not name the first revision whose default-policy arm regresses, nor does a landed paragraph state the whole ladder is one way with the ladder actually walked; the negative control is recorded and reproduces (b43714114 forced-one-trip: residual 0.2586805230398537, converged=false, guard fired 'converged assertion refused: forced_one_trip ... converged=False trips=1', verified against the raw log). The plan gains no attribution paragraph on main because none of the commits landed.
item_verdicts.goal: under a coordinator redirect recorded in needs-help.md, the node pivoted from the full nine-revision ladder to (a) a cancelled partial ladder that establishes analytic-hex is already unconverged at the very first tested revision, b43714114, for both cases, and (b) an independently-built four-arm production-vs-analytic-hex comparison at f5af729a9 finding both constructions unconverged in both cases with only carrier identity and seed bytes differing. This is a legitimate, well-instrumented diagnostic pivot and its numbers reproduce exactly from the committed JSON, but it substitutes for, rather than delivers, the plan's stated goal, and the substitution and its artifacts are stranded off main.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory: status complete, fifteen commits, orientation_write_paths matching changed_paths, a described H200 job (1276214, COMPLETED, 00:30:31), review-constructions.py and reckon audit-doc both reported passing, a negative_control_log that reproduces verbatim. reckon crew check-manifest is not itself re-run here, but every numeric claim I spot-checked against the on-disk JSON artifacts (exact-mode-construction-comparison.json's four arms; exact-mode-fixed-point-attribution.json's row census of 3 measured / 6 not-measured / 10 not-run) matches exactly. The one fact the manifest does not carry is that its own committed revision is unreachable from HEAD.
item_verdicts.write_paths: all changed_paths sit inside the declared orientation_write_paths (benchmarks/plasma_cell_fixed_point_attribution.py, docs/figures/plasma-cell-read-fidelity/*, docs/plans/plasma-cell-read-fidelity.html, docs/evidence/archive/plasma-cell-read-fidelity-landed.html, the reports directory); nothing under nova/ or tests/ is touched, correct for a measurement-only node. `git status --porcelain` at the reviewed worktree tip is empty.

justifications.durability: the entire delivery is off main: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 065fb75de6165c458b3e64f787929055c82324ff HEAD` fails, `git for-each-ref` shows the tip is reachable only through `worktrees/pcrf-attribute-the-exact-mode-fixed-point/HEAD` with no branch pointing at it, and HEAD:benchmarks/plasma_cell_fixed_point_attribution.py and HEAD:docs/figures/.../exact-mode-construction-comparison.png both fail to resolve. This worktree is one `git worktree remove --force` or an unattended prune away from losing fifteen commits outright (the sibling review worktree assigned to this task was itself removed from disk mid-session by something outside this review). Nothing re-runs this benchmark on any test lane. Until a coordinator merges it, none of this evidence exists for any reader of main or the docs server.
justifications.evidence: every load-bearing number I checked reproduced exactly from the committed artifacts rather than from the manifest's prose: exact-mode-construction-comparison.json's four arms (production/analytic_hex x diverted/reactor-static) match the manifest's residuals and trip counts to the last decimal; exact-mode-fixed-point-attribution.json's row census (3 measured, 6 not-measured, 10 not-run, verdict nonconvergence_predates_ladder_window, explicitly qualified as not an all-revision claim) matches the checkpoint's description; the negative-control log at b43714114 reproduces the declared refusal string and residual verbatim. The one unverified inference is the discriminator itself: the claim that the historically-converged receipt used the production construction rather than analytic-hex is stated as the resolution but was never tested by running the production construction at the seed revision b43714114 -- only at main.
justifications.fit: benchmarks/plasma_cell_fixed_point_attribution.py is named for the mechanism it measures, carries no plan/sprint/ticket label in any symbol, path or comment, and every commit subject is conventional with a body and no AI attribution; the figure work reuses the committed nova.media painters (draw_wall, _draw_nulls, shared contour levels) rather than inventing new plotting code.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the delivered measurement is real, instrumented and partially answers the section's question (the ladder premise that a landing regressed convergence is refuted at the one rung actually tested, and the construction comparison is a genuinely new, correctly-scoped diagnostic), but the plan's literal done-when — attribution across the full nine-revision window — was abandoned under a coordinator redirect that is recorded only in an internal needs-help note, not in any paragraph reachable from main; and the redirect's own explanatory claim rests on an untested inference rather than a measured fact.
justifications.scope_discipline: every commit stays inside the declared write fence, no nova/ or tests/ file is touched, nine scratch revision worktrees were built and torn down without leaving stray state, and the worker correctly left plan-state closure (section status, followup resolution) to the coordinator. The one scope-adjacent defect is that 'complete' is asserted for a delivery that never crossed into the shared branch the fence exists to protect.
